mapper.update: UPDATE invocation SET state='SUCCEEDED',output_snapshot=#{output},output_digest=#{digest},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND id=#{invocation} AND state='WAITING_USER'
UPDATE reservation SET state='SETTLED',actual=1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{invocation} AND category='TOOL' AND state='RESERVED'
